bio: Fruit, vegetables, grains and pulses all get their moment in the spotlight at this fully vegan restaurant with stripped-back, bistro-like interiors and an open kitchen. The menu is ideal for sharing, offering original, delicately flavoured and well-balanced dishes such as fried polenta with agave and chilli syrup. Make sure you save room for the ‘sfinci’ doughnuts and homemade jam. Attentive and efficient service keeps things running smoothly.
